text_raw: Reminder: your dental appointment is tomorrow at 9 am. Please arrive ten minutes early for registration.
Your clinic appointment is scheduled for Friday morning. Reply if you need to reschedule.
The specialist has an earlier slot available this afternoon. Call us if you would like to take it.
Please collect your prescription before the pharmacy closes tonight.
Your vaccination appointment is due next week. You may change the date through the clinic portal.
Your medical report is ready for collection. The records counter closes at 5 pm.
The doctor has requested a follow-up within two weeks. Please book a suitable time when convenient.
Your physiotherapy session starts in thirty minutes. Let us know if you are running late.
The clinic will close early today for maintenance. Please collect any medication before 4 pm.
Your appointment deposit is due by Thursday to keep the booking. Contact us if you need assistance.
Your credit card payment is due this Friday. You can pay through the official banking app.
Your monthly loan instalment is due on the fifteenth. No action is needed if you have automatic payment enabled.
Your bank statement for this month is now available in the mobile app.
Your fixed deposit matures next Monday. You can review your options after logging in normally.
A scheduled transfer will be processed tomorrow. You can cancel it in the app before midnight if needed.
Your debit card expires next month. A replacement card will be mailed to your registered address.
Your account balance is below the minimum required for fee waiver this month.
We noticed a card transaction overseas. Review it in your banking app when you have time.
Your e-statement is ready. Please sign in through the official website to view it.
Your recurring payment will be charged tomorrow according to your existing instructions.
Your mobile plan renews tonight at the usual monthly fee. No action is required.
Your broadband contract ends this month. You may renew or switch plans before the expiry date.
Planned maintenance will affect internet service between 2 am and 4 am tonight.
Your electricity bill is due next Wednesday. Payment can be made through the usual official channels.
Water service in your block will be interrupted tomorrow morning for scheduled maintenance.
Your prepaid mobile balance expires at the end of the month if it is not used.
Your data allowance is almost used up for this billing cycle. Extra charges may apply according to your plan.
Your technician appointment is tomorrow between 1 pm and 3 pm. Please ensure someone is home.
The promotional rate on your current phone plan ends this Sunday. Your normal rate will apply after that.
Your utilities account has an outstanding amount. Please review the bill in the provider's official app.
Course registration closes tomorrow evening. Submit your choices through the student portal before then.
Your assignment is due at 11:59 pm tonight. Extensions must be requested through your lecturer.
Please submit your timesheet by noon Friday so payroll can process it on time.
The meeting has been moved forward to 2 pm today. Please update your calendar.
Applications for the workshop close at the end of this week.
Your library loan is due tomorrow. Renew it online if you still need the book.
The lab booking will be released after fifteen minutes if nobody checks in.
Please complete the mandatory training module by the end of the month.
The office will close at 3 pm on Friday. Collect any documents you need before then.
Your leave request needs a response from your manager before the roster is finalised.
Your parcel is arriving today between 3 pm and 6 pm. You can track it in the courier app.
Check-in for your flight closes one hour before departure. Please arrive at the airport early.
Your hotel reservation can be cancelled without charge until 6 pm tomorrow.
The restaurant will hold your table for fifteen minutes after the reservation time.
Your train departs from platform four in twenty minutes.
Boarding begins at 7:10 pm. Please have your boarding pass ready.
Your delivery driver is nearby and may call when reaching the lobby.
The pickup point closes at 9 pm tonight. Uncollected parcels will remain available tomorrow.
Your event tickets must be downloaded before entering the venue.
The promotional fare expires tonight, but regular tickets will still be available afterward.
For your safety, never share your one-time password with anyone, including bank staff.
If a caller asks you to transfer money urgently, end the call and contact the organisation through its official number.
We detected an unsuccessful login attempt. You can review recent activity after signing in through the official app.
Your password will expire in seven days. Change it through the company portal before then.
A security update is available for your device. Install it when convenient from the official settings menu.
If you did not make this purchase, freeze your card in the app and contact the bank using the number printed on your card.
Do not approve login requests you did not initiate. Report suspicious activity through the official support page.
Your workplace account will require multi-factor authentication starting next month.
A weather advisory is in effect this afternoon. Avoid exposed areas if thunderstorms develop.
The building fire alarm will be tested at 10 am. No evacuation is required unless instructed otherwise.
